name: git-workflow
description: Consistent Commitizen commits and pull request descriptions for Git repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Create consistent commits and pull requests.
interface.longDescription: Uses each repository's Commitizen configuration and branch changes to prepare validated commit messages and useful pull request descriptions.
defaultPrompt: Prepare my changes for a Commitizen commit and pull request.
Draft a validated commit message for my staged changes.
Create a pull request description from this branch.
